book.name: Jeramaiya
book.title: Jeramaiya Jeramaiya Bin Gibit Wed Brom God

content: YAWEI bin meigim pramis langa Baruk
Langa det namba 4 yiya wen Jehoiyakim det san blanga Josaiya bin jidan king langa Juda, Baruk bin raidimdan langa peipa wanim aibin dalim im. Aibin dalim im
wanim YAWEI det trubala God blanga ola Isreil pipul bin tok,

“Baruk, yu oldei toktok, ‘Wal ai garra lafta gibap na, dumaji YAWEI bin meigim mi abum detmatj trabul en imbin meigim mi jidan brabli nogudbinjiwan na. Mi brabli wikwan brom toktokbat, en ai kaan abum gudwan spel, najing.’
“Bat mi na YAWEI. Ai garra breigimdan wanim aibin bildimap, en ai garra pulumap wanim aibin plentim. Ai garra dum lagijat na langa holot dijan wel.

Yu reken ai garra dum speshalwan ting blanga yu? Yu nomo lagijat. Ai garra bringimap brabli nogudbala ting langa ola pipul langa ebri kantri, bat yu Baruk, nomeda wujei yu go ai garra maindimbat yu en yu garra jidan laibala.” Lagijat na YAWEI bin tok.
